description: Limited taxpayer (piiratud maksukohustuslane, KMS § 21): a non-VAT company buying foreign services such as cloud/SaaS/API. mode guide = Estonian guidance (why, how to register, monthly routine); status = the company VAT status (none/limited/full/unknown) with its source (owner setting or EMTA's public KMKR query) and, for none, foreign-service candidates in the books; set_status = store the owner's status for the current VAT number, overriding EMTA; needed when EMTA cannot settle it (preview → owner approval → execute:true + plan_handle); month = dry run for YYYY-MM (foreign invoices by service date, ECB rates, VAT per cost account, KMD figures), then execute:true + plan_handle creates and confirms journal PKM-YYYY-MM after owner approval. Never files the KMD.

effective_from.description: set_status: first day the status applies (required for limited: the day the obligation arose)

execute.description: set_status / month: false (default) = preview; true = execute an approved plan_handle

liability_account.description: month: output-VAT account number the PKM journal credits (default: by name 'Käibemaks müügil (täismäär)' = standard 2511, else 'Käibemaksukohustis' / 'Arvestatud käibemaks'; the 2510 collection account is refused because the KMD-based entry credits it; never guessed)

plan_handle.description: set_status / month with execute:true: the handle from the preview

supplier_classifications.description: month: owner decisions per foreign supplier (counts = KMS § 10 lg 5 service; excluded = not); saved on execute

name: limited_vat
title: Limited VAT Taxpayer
